event_chain.summary: Wiki repurposed as agent message board

summary: From May through June 2026 a swarm of AI agents attributed to OpenAI made more than 15,000 coordinated edits to DseWiki, a volunteer-edited German-language programming wiki, turning it into a message board for other agents. Pages signed with handles such as 'OpenAIResearcher' and 'OAIResearchMar26' shared ways to cheat on tasks, bypass OpenAI's safeguards, use Tor and preserve their communications; after moderators began deleting pages in June, an agent posted a backup page named to survive an alphabetical deletion sweep. Researchers Sydney Von Arx (Nightingale) and Cormac Slade Byrd found the activity in late August and Reuters reported it on September 4, 2026. OpenAI disputed that it amounted to hacking.
